results.question: 查询一段时间内所有水质站的水质变化趋势。
results.expected_sql:
SELECT b.stnm AS '测站',
       ROUND(AVG(d.dox), 2) AS '平均DO(mg/L)', ROUND(AVG(d.codmn), 2) AS '平均CODMn(mg/L)',
       ROUND(AVG(d.nh3n), 3) AS '平均NH3N(mg/L)', ROUND(AVG(d.tp), 3) AS '平均TP(mg/L)',
       ROUND(AVG(d.ph), 2) AS '平均pH', ROUND(AVG(d.wtmp), 1) AS '平均水温(℃)'
FROM sl325.wq_pcp_d d
JOIN sl323.st_stbprp_b b ON d.stcd = b.stcd
WHERE b.sttp = 'WQ'
  AND d.spt >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY b.stnm
ORDER BY b.stnm;

## 水质变化趋势查询结果

**查询时间范围：** 2026-07-02 至 2026-07-31（近30天）
**覆盖站点数：** 65个水质监测站（共79个水质站中有数据）

### 一、区域水质总体趋势

![水质指标变化趋势](https://mdn.alipayobjects.com/one_clip/afts/img/c9f3R7t1aGwAAAAAUrAAAAgAoEACAQFr/original)

**核心指标均值（30天平均）：**

| 指标 | 均值 | 范围 | 评价 |
|------|------|------|------|
| 溶解氧 (DO) | 7.46 mg/L | 7.42~7.50 | 良好 |
| CODMn | 4.60 mg/L | 4.57~4.62 | 中等 |
| 氨氮 (NH3N) | 0.560 mg/L | 0.555~0.565 | 中等 |
| 总磷 (TP) | 0.246 mg/L | 0.242~0.250 | 中等 |
| pH | 7.94 | 7.91~7.98 | 正常 |
| 水温 | 16.8 ℃ | 16.7~16.9 | — |

**趋势特征：**
- 各项指标在30天内波动极小，整体水质保持**相对稳定**
- 溶解氧维持在 7.4~7.5 mg/L，水体溶解氧充足
- CODMn 在 4.57~4.62 mg/L 窄幅波动，有机污染负荷基本恒定
- 氨氮、总磷变化幅度很小，无明显恶化或改善趋势

### 二、重点站点水质情况（部分）

| 测站名 | 溶解氧 | CODMn | 氨氮 | 总磷 | 水质概况 |
|--------|--------|-------|------|------|----------|
| 武汤大桥 | 9.09 | 2.20 | 0.210 | 0.110 | 水质优良 |
| 三江营 | 9.58 | 1.40 | 0.040 | 0.060 | 水质优良 |
| 反修桥 | 9.21 | 1.60 | 0.080 | 0.050 | 水质优良 |
| 瘦西湖水质站 | 4.02 | 2.90 | 0.581 | 0.110 | 溶解氧偏低 |
| 望直电厂 | 2.99 | 5.61 | 2.928 | 0.280 | 水质较差 |
| 郑西桥 | 7.51 | 7.91 | 1.409 | 0.269 | CODMn偏高 |
| 仪扬河上游 | — | 10.11 | 1.127 | 0.110 | CODMn较高 |
| 入仪扬河口 | 2.99 | 10.52 | 0.349 | 0.150 | CODMn高、DO低 |
| 七里河 | 8.78 | 6.09 | 7.965 | 7.984 | 氨氮/总磷异常高 |
| 红旗河闸内 | 1.00 | 9.45 | 1.368 | 0.030 | 溶解氧极低 |

### 三、水质等级评估（单因子评价法）

根据 GB 3838-2002 地表水环境质量标准，区域整体水质大致为 **Ⅲ~Ⅳ类**：
- **优良站点**（Ⅱ~Ⅲ类）：武汤大桥、三江营、反修桥、胜利桥等上游站点水质较好
- **一般站点**（Ⅲ~Ⅳ类）：大部分站点 CODMn 在 4~6 mg/L，氨氮 0.2~0.8 mg/L
- **较差站点**（Ⅴ~劣Ⅴ类）：望直电厂、七里河、红旗河闸内等站点存在明显污染问题，溶解氧偏低、氨氮超标

### 四、总结

近30天区域水质整体**稳定**，无明显趋势性变化。上游站点水质优良，部分城区河道和闸内站点水质较差，需重点关注望直电厂、七里河、红旗河闸内等站点的水质改善。

SELECT DATE(d.spt) AS '日期',
         COUNT(DISTINCT d.stcd) AS '站点数',
         ROUND(AVG(d.dox),2)   AS '溶解氧均值(mg/L)',
         ROUND(AVG(d.codmn),2) AS 'CODMn均值(mg/L)',
         ROUND(AVG(d.nh3n),3)  AS '氨氮均值(mg/L)',
         ROUND(AVG(d.tp),3)    AS '总磷均值(mg/L)',
         ROUND(AVG(d.ph),2)    AS 'pH均值',
         ROUND(AVG(d.wtmp),1)  AS '水温均值(℃)'
  FROM sl325.wq_pcp_d d
  JOIN sl323.st_stbprp_b b ON d.stcd = b.stcd
  WHERE b.sttp='WQ'
    AND d.spt > DATE_SUB((SELECT MAX(spt) FROM sl325.wq_pcp_d), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  GROUP BY DATE(d.spt) ORDER BY DATE(d.spt)
  LIMIT 60
SELECT MIN(spt) AS min_spt, MAX(spt) AS max_spt, COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM sl325.wq_pcp_d

SELECT d.stcd, d.spt, d.dox, d.codmn, d.nh3n, d.tp, d.ph
FROM sl325.wq_pcp_d d
ORDER BY d.spt DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT MAX(spt) AS max_spt FROM sl325.wq_pcp_d WHERE spt <= CURDATE()

SELECT DATE(d.spt) AS '日期',
         COUNT(DISTINCT d.stcd) AS '站点数',
         ROUND(AVG(d.dox),2)   AS '溶解氧均值(mg/L)',
         ROUND(AVG(d.codmn),2) AS 'CODMn均值(mg/L)',
         ROUND(AVG(d.nh3n),3)  AS '氨氮均值(mg/L)',
         ROUND(AVG(d.tp),3)    AS '总磷均值(mg/L)',
         ROUND(AVG(d.ph),2)    AS 'pH均值',
         ROUND(AVG(d.wtmp),1)  AS '水温均值(℃)'
  FROM sl325.wq_pcp_d d
  JOIN sl323.st_stbprp_b b ON d.stcd = b.stcd
  WHERE b.sttp='WQ'
    AND d.spt > DATE_SUB((SELECT MAX(spt) FROM sl325.wq_pcp_d WHERE spt <= CURDATE()), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
    AND d.spt <= CURDATE()
  GROUP BY DATE(d.spt) ORDER BY DATE(d.spt)
  LIMIT 60

SELECT b.stnm AS '测站名',
         ROUND(AVG(d.dox),2)   AS '溶解氧均值(mg/L)',
         ROUND(AVG(d.codmn),2) AS 'CODMn均值(mg/L)',
         ROUND(AVG(d.nh3n),3)  AS '氨氮均值(mg/L)',
         ROUND(AVG(d.tp),3)    AS '总磷均值(mg/L)',
         ROUND(AVG(d.ph),2)    AS 'pH均值',
         COUNT(*) AS '采样次数'
  FROM sl325.wq_pcp_d d
  JOIN sl323.st_stbprp_b b ON d.stcd = b.stcd
  WHERE b.sttp='WQ'
    AND d.spt > DATE_SUB((SELECT MAX(spt) FROM sl325.wq_pcp_d WHERE spt <= CURDATE()), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
    AND d.spt <= CURDATE()
  GROUP BY b.stnm
  ORDER BY '采样次数' DESC
  LIMIT 80
